title: Accessor
description: A typed view into a buffer view that contains raw binary data.

bufferView.gltf_detailedDescription: The index of the buffer view. When undefined, the accessor **MUST** be initialized with zeros; `sparse` property or extensions **MAY** override zeros with actual values.

byteOffset.description: The offset relative to the start of the buffer view in bytes.
byteOffset.gltf_detailedDescription: The offset relative to the start of the buffer view in bytes.  This **MUST** be a multiple of the size of the component datatype. This property **MUST NOT** be defined when `bufferView` is undefined.

componentType.description: The datatype of the accessor's components.

anyOf.description: 8-bit signed integer (sint8) or 8-bit signed normalized integer (snorm8).
8-bit unsigned integer (uint8) or 8-bit unsigned normalized integer (unorm8).
16-bit signed integer (sint16) or 16-bit signed normalized integer (snorm16).
16-bit unsigned integer (uint16) or 16-bit unsigned normalized integer (unorm16).
32-bit floating-point number (float32) in IEEE 754 single-precision format (binary32).
64-bit floating-point number (float64) in IEEE 754 double-precision format (binary64).
16-bit floating-point number (float16) in IEEE 754 half-precision format (binary16).

count.description: The number of elements referenced by this accessor.
count.gltf_detailedDescription: The number of elements referenced by this accessor, not to be confused with the number of bytes or number of components.

max.description: Maximum value of each component in this accessor.
max.gltf_detailedDescription:
Maximum value of each component in this accessor.  Array elements **MUST** be treated as having the same data type as accessor's `componentType`. Both `min` and `max` arrays have the same length.  The length is determined by the value of the `type` property; it can be 1, 2, 3, 4, 9, or 16.

`normalized` property has no effect on array values: they always correspond to the actual values stored in the buffer. When the accessor is sparse, this property **MUST** contain maximum values of accessor data with sparse substitution applied.

min.description: Minimum value of each component in this accessor.
min.gltf_detailedDescription:
Minimum value of each component in this accessor.  Array elements **MUST** be treated as having the same data type as accessor's `componentType`. Both `min` and `max` arrays have the same length.  The length is determined by the value of the `type` property; it can be 1, 2, 3, 4, 9, or 16.

`normalized` property has no effect on array values: they always correspond to the actual values stored in the buffer. When the accessor is sparse, this property **MUST** contain minimum values of accessor data with sparse substitution applied.

normalized.description: Specifies whether integer data values are normalized before usage.
normalized.gltf_detailedDescription: Specifies whether integer data values are normalized (`true`) to [0, 1] (for unsigned types) or to [-1, 1] (for signed types) when they are accessed. This property **MUST NOT** be set to `true` for accessors with a component type of `5124` (sint32), `5125` (uint32), `5126` (float32), `5130` (float64), `5131` (float16), `5134` (sint64), or `5135` (uint64).

sparse.description: Sparse storage of elements that deviate from their initialization value.

type.description: Specifies if the accessor's elements are scalars, vectors, or matrices.
